title: Vehicle recall notice
description: Notify owners of a safety recall on WhatsApp with the affected model and how to book a free repair. Utility safety alert for dealers.
notes: Recalls are safety-critical and not promotional, so utility fits. State the free repair and avoid sales language.

body.text: Important safety notice for your {{vehicle}} (VIN ending {{vin_end}}). The manufacturer issued a recall for {{issue}}. The repair is free of charge. Please book your appointment as soon as possible.
